headline_stat.name: wake-sleep HD-cell pairwise correlation preservation (REM), pooled 313 pairs

stated_limitation: their preferred directions tile the circle without significant clustering (resultant R = 0.21, uniformity p = 0.09)

justification.dataset: DANDI 000056 (Peyrache ADn/postsubiculum) is a canonical head-direction dataset in the expected species, region, and paradigm.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, HD reconstructed from LED difference vector with sentinel masking, state epochs and units correctly loaded with defensive sorting.
justification.analysis: Circular statistics used throughout, occupancy-matched random-time null with justified rationale, effect-size floor, GLM encoding, Bayesian decoding, and permutation-tested correlation preservation all correct.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (53/159 cells, MVL 0.57, R 0.21, 313 pairs, r 0.92/0.90) reproduces exactly from the committed cache and is internally consistent and physically possible.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, show all HD cells rather than flattering examples, and the phenomenon is unmistakably visible in tuning curves, raster, and correlation matrices.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and several borderline cases are surfaced inline (non-significant clustering p=0.09, GLM fit for only six of seven cells, informative-bin restriction), though there is no dedicated limitations discussion of the strong result.
